findings.reason: the plan must name which side owns the composition (the router publishes `admission.headroom` and the top-level bound; readers copy it) rather than leave a local recompute that the plan's own stated rule forbids, or reconcile the fallback explicitly as the owner.
findings.text: reckon's `_admission_reading` and `_minimum_headroom` recompute, against `lane.json`, the admission headroom, the gate-slot count and the `min(engine, admission)` rule that `imas_ambix/agent/lane.py:725` (`lane_headroom`) and `:704` (`engine_headroom`) already own; the two readers are the min-composition and slot arithmetic with two authors, and §21's addendum rules that a reader "cop[ies], never recompute[s]"

findings.reason: the plan should state why the field lists live in a second module rather than the lane reader, or fold them into it; the nested `worker_slots.worker_slots` is the tell that the layer adds surface rather than depth.
findings.text: `ADMISSION_FIELDS`, `WORKER_SLOT_FIELDS` and `SESSION_SLOT_FIELDS` copy slices of the `admission` block that `imas_ambix/agent/lane.py`'s document reader already resolves, adding a third reader of the same fields and nesting the count at `lane.worker_slots.worker_slots`; §21's addendum asks gpu-watch to print the figure but never says why the existing lane reader cannot expose it, which is the thin-layer-over-existing-machinery case the item exists for

findings.reason: with the week's four families supplied as 0, the sections that add to the CLI and to the published lane contract must justify the addition against a retirement or merge, as §15 does for the implicit gate path and §17 does for the run-level drain.
findings.text: §18 adds `agent pause --cut` and `--cut-form close|error` to the CLI and §21/§22 add five `admission` fields (`active_sessions`, `fair_share`, `borrow_reserve`, `new_session_worker_slots`, `sessions`), and neither section states what it retires or merges, or why nothing can be; the read-back definitions §21/§22 do compile resolve field semantics but do not account for the added surface

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the admission control (FIFO, pause, cut, live width, occupancy rule, slot derivation) is hidden behind one gate interface (`_GenerationGate.acquire`/`release`/`snapshot` over `_AdmissionLedger`), which is substantial behaviour behind a small surface; the plan does not sprawl it across many shallow wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan's own rule "Readers copy, never recompute" is violated by the reader it names as the owner: reckon's `lane_document.py` re-derives the same headroom composition and slot arithmetic that `imas_ambix/agent/lane.py` already implements, over the same `lane.json` block.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §18 and §21/§22 add a CLI option and five lane-document fields without naming what they retire or merge, or why nothing can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §14 carries an explicit reuse map naming `fetch_lane_capacity`/`LaneCapacity`, `engine_metrics.COUNTER_SERIES`, `receipt_bins.py` and `bench.py`, and §21/§22 name `identity_from_headers`, `lane.py` and reckon's reader, so each new mechanism cites the machinery it extends or declines.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: a finding — the plan adds a copying layer (`live_panel.py`'s three admission field-list constants) over fields a reader in the same repository already resolves, without saying why that reader cannot carry them.
